tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All terms and conditions as per the tender document.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Applicant should have positive Networth in the preceding three financial years, i.e., certified by Chartered Accountant with UDIN number FY 2022-23 (AY 2023-24) FY 2023-24 (AY 2024-25) FY 2024-25 (AY 2025-26)

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Annual Turnover and Networth statement certified by Chartered Accountant as per format enclosed in RFP.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Applicant should have executed at least one (1) order having 100 ICT Highly Skilled or Skilled manpower resources to Central Government / State Government / Public Sector Undertaking during the preceding five (5) financial years. OR Applicant should have executed at least two (2) orders with each order having 50 ICT Highly Skilled or Skilled manpower resources to Central Government / State Government / Public Sector Undertaking during the preceding five (5) financial years. OR Applicant should have executed at least four (4) orders with each order having 25 ICT Highly Skilled or Skilled manpower resources to Central Government / State Government / Public Sector Undertaking during the preceding five (5) financial years. OR Applicant should have executed at least five (5) orders with each order having 20 ICT Highly Skilled or Skilled manpower resources to Central Government / State Government / Public Sector Undertaking during the preceding five (5) financial years.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Copy of Service order / work order
